decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered (791/204 C, 791/206 C Received 28/04/2011, 791/205 A Received 01/04/2011, 791/200 B, 791/202 B, 791/203 B Received 23/02/2011 and 791/201, 791/207 Received 02/02/2011) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The pointing and mortar to be used in the infilling of the pedestrian access in the wall fronting Park Road to the south of Ferry House (plan number 791/205 A) should match that of the original wall.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until works to install the two timber posts and raise the kerb of the existing crossover shown on plan number 791/206 A have been completed as approved.
description: Alterations to increase the width of the existing opening in the brick wall fronting Park Road to create a vehicular access and installation of new timber gates; to widen an opening in the existing brick garden wall to rear (north of house) together with installation of replacement timber gates in the wall fronting the Syon Park driveway. (M00858/A/P2 - Planning application)
